baseline.name: Compare all unordered value pairs
baseline.approach: Examine each pair to find the minimum absolute difference and collect all matching pairs.
baseline.space: Output storage plus O(1) comparison state

archived.name: Sort and compare adjacent values
archived.time: Usually O(n log n), then two O(n) scans

why: For sorted distinct values, a minimum-difference pair is adjacent, so nonadjacent pair comparisons are unnecessary.
quantitative_comparison: The baseline evaluates n(n-1)/2 pairs. After sorting, the archive examines n-1 adjacent differences in each of two passes; sorting remains part of the cost, so these counts are not a speed ratio.
tradeoffs: Mutates input order and relies on bounded int differences and successful allocations. C does not specify qsort's algorithmic bound; small inputs may not benefit from sorting overhead.
evidence_basis: Static adjacent-pair theorem applied to the captured loops; no paired timing.
